entity: Senate Banking Committee members as a group: their share of bank-stock trades vs their share of trading senators, 2012-20
why: The headline's subject is the committee membership as a group, 19% of traders vs 34% of bank trades. Sources cover one member (Perdue's bank trades while on the committee) and the general committee-overlap trading pattern, but none states the group-level share finding; the NBER paper measures returns, a different measure, so it doesn't contradict a volume-share claim.
